title: Payload of `hello`
description: node → gateway: an existing node's reply to `challenge` (§6.1 step 5). The envelope signature (`node-msg`) covers the challenge's `nonce`. `resume` is the node's own record of what it has shown, per reply; `last_seq` is any integer, validated by the gateway (R6-5), written as an integer literal: a number with a fraction or an exponent (`2.0`, `1e18`) is refused whatever its value. `clock_skew_ms` is present only when the node's clock differs from the challenge's `issued_at` by more than 30 s (advisory).

nonce.description: 32 random bytes, base64url without padding (43 characters); the challenge's nonce.
